sceneConcept: A severe fifty-year-old Chinese Black Prison warden stands rigidly against a transparent background. Close-cropped completely white hair, grey eyes and a gaunt lined face make him look prematurely aged. He wears an austere black high-collared warden coat over a charcoal protective vest, black gloves, utility belt, straight trousers and visibly scuffed old combat boots. A small dormant brushed-steel interface plate behind his left ear connects to one short black cable clipped neatly to his collar. His hands are held behind his back. Soft even frontal studio light reveals the equipment without glow. Visual refresh: the restraint-network connector made clearly visible behind the ear above an old severe long coat.
naturalLanguageDetail: A gaunt severe fifty-year-old Chinese prison warden with close-cropped completely white hair stands rigidly with his hands behind his back, wearing an austere black high-collared coat and one visible brushed-steel restraint-network interface behind his left ear under soft even frontal studio light; the portrait is a strict cowboy shot whose lower edge cuts across both thighs clearly above the knees.
